exposure: Previous uterine manipulations (c-section, D&C, operative hysteroscopy, etc.)
cohort: 330 women diagnosed with abnormal placentation (placenta previa and PAS) who gave birth at Nadezhda Hospital, from March 2013 to August 2021
finding: The study found a higher frequency of placenta previa in their population than worldwide reported data, and a three-times higher risk of placenta previa in pregnancies following ART.
